notes: Deterministic redaction via @pharmatools/redacta — runs locally, no network.
'clinical' catches NHS numbers (Modulus-11 validated), NI numbers, dates of birth, postcodes, phones, emails, hospital/MRN numbers, and keyword-anchored patient/relative/carer names.
'general' adds URLs, IPs, Luhn-validated payment cards, IBANs, account numbers, and vehicle registrations.
Add 'safeharbor' for a stricter US HIPAA Safe Harbor pass: ALL dates, specific ages, fax, licence, device serial, VIN, and health-plan numbers.

Limits: deterministic + keyword-anchored detection only. Names in free prose are NOT caught. This is a strong first line of defence, not a guarantee — review the redaction report before anything sensitive leaves your machine.
